attribution.title: Amsterdam Dungeon / Nieuwezijds Kapel
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free model scoped to the two actual buildings used by Amsterdam Dungeon: currentPDOK Rokin78 bijeenkomstfunctie1277m² VBO0363010003702386 is linked to both BAG2168346 (chapel/side rooms) and2175269 (entrance wing). Other RCE518455 compound buildings including Rokin80/82 BAG2175268 andKalverstraat81/87 BAG2168348 remain visible and unsuppressed. PrimaryArcam exterior confirms two gabled venue wings and portal; the neighboring streetcorner dome is outside model scope. Original octagonal chapel,tent roof/open lantern,sculpted brick gables,stone bands and measured lower wings refer to Posthumus Meyjes’1908–1912 architecture. Heights approximate13.3–17.8m front,7–16m side rooms,18m chapel eaves,24.7m truncated tent roof and29m lantern: AHN5 raw height26.9m and reconstructedplanepeaks29.1m differ; OSM32.3m is not used as a flat mass. Exact mapped recesses retained; no imported mesh faces or textures.
